# gcxtras_sta_program (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Genesys Cloud Speech and Text Analytics Program by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcxtras_sta_program" "example" {
  name = "General"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the program to look up.

### Read-Only

- `default_program` (Boolean) Whether this is the default program.
- `description` (String) The description of the program.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the program is published.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags associated with the program.
- `topic_ids` (List of String) List of topic IDs associated with the program.
